jobs.description:
An international company based in Zaventem is looking for an Allround Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. 

In this role, you will support a broad range of accounting activities, including invoice processing, bank bookings, reconciliations, monthly closing, reporting and audit support. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and contribute to improving accounting processes. Are you ready for the next step in your career? Don't hesitate to apply.

Your responsibilities:

• Process sales, purchase and general expense invoices in SAP.
• Perform daily bank bookings, reconciliations and account checks.
• Review and follow up on invoices, open items and DMS workflows.
• Process employee expense claims through SAP.
• Support monthly closing, reporting, accruals and reconciliations.
• Prepare documentation for audits and J-SOX requirements.
• Assist with fixed assets, stock counts and other accounting tasks.
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-processing questions.
• Contribute to process improvements.
• Provide back-up support to the wider accounting team when needed.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• At least 2 years of relevant accounting experience.
• Good knowledge of accounting principles.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• Good MS Office/Excel skills.
• Accurate, organized and detail-oriented.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and a strong team player.
• Fluent in English and good knowledge of French and Dutch.

The opportunity

Our Client designs, supports and maintains IT solutions for mission-critical operations at international customer sites — where conventional IT meets industrial operational technology, and reliability, clear communication and disciplined execution really matter. We're strengthening our Service Desk with an experienced Level 2 engineer who takes end-to-end ownership, collaborates across teams, keeps customers informed, and helps the whole support organization work more consistently and effectively.
What you'll do

• Own assigned incidents and service requests end-to-end — from acceptance through resolution, validation and documented closure

• Diagnose complex application, infrastructure, integration, database and OS issues using logs, traces and structured troubleshooting

• Restore service via remote or on-site intervention, respecting operational, security and change-control requirements

• Analyze problems, reproduce defects in lab/virtual environments, and collaborate with Development and DevOps on fixes

• Perform planned preventive and corrective maintenance, and support release validation and go-live readiness

• Maintain documentation, build knowledge articles, and drive continuous improvement across the support organization

Why join us

• Work on technically varied systems supporting real-time, mission-critical operations

• Combine IT, OT, customer interaction, troubleshooting, maintenance and improvement in one role

• Collaborate with experienced support, operations, development, DevOps and project teams

• Grow within an international technology group with a global customer footprint

• 3+ years of hands-on Level 2 (or equivalent) IT application/infrastructure support in a business-critical environment

• Strong troubleshooting across Windows and/or Linux, networks, services, logs, databases and distributed applications

• Experience with incident, request, problem and change practices in an ITIL-aligned organization

• Clear technical writing in English; working proficiency in French (must have) and Dutch

• Valid category B driving license; willing to travel to customer sites and join a compensated on-call rotation

 

Nice to have:

• Microsoft Server stack (Windows Server, IIS, SQL Server) and/or Linux/Unix administration

• Relational & NoSQL platforms: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch

• Integration, APIs, messaging & MicroServices (e.g. ActiveMQ, Apache Camel)

• Scripting/automation in Python, PowerShell, JavaScript or C#

• Experience in industrial IT/OT or other 24/7 operational environments; Jira & Confluence

 

The mindset we're looking for:

You take ownership rather than waiting for others to unblock a ticket, and you stay accountable until a sound handover or closure. You collaborate constructively, communicate calmly under pressure, and stay curious — turning lessons into documentation or automation. You troubleshoot methodically, respect procedures, and are reliable when it matters most.

jobs.occupation: International Inside Sales - High-Performance Metal Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Italian is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees

• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Are you commercially minded and do you enjoy working with customers? Are you looking for a job that is never the same and where you get opportunities to grow?

Then maybe you are our new CUSTOMER CARE REPRESENTATIVE!

For our client, the largest private rail freight operator in Europe, we are looking for a customer care representative to join the Freight Force.

As a customer care representative you will: Process owner for the booking & check-in process
  
• You accept bookings on customer request  
• You make bookings yourself of containers and wagons on trains and you send the booking instructions and agreements to Order Management  
• You inform and make the customer acquainted with the Customer Portal so that he is able to makes his own bookings. You assist the customer in every step of the booking process.  
• You manage changes of the original booking  
• You check if basic commercial data is known and is supported via the Customer Portal. If no, you inform and request assistance from Inside Sales to amend lacking commercial information  
• You rectify the missing and/or wrong contract number for import orders to ensure quick O2C  
• You make sure that all booking details are correct and that there are no anomalies that can slow down the order-to-cash process  
• You prepare template of the railway bill/consignment note.  
• You make the consignment note (as a paid service or if in high special need for assistance)
Commercial tasks
  
• You are able to maximize the fill rate of each train by finding the extra box/wagon and by consulting the customer on a professional and commercial way (based on parameters of Commercial Margin Management)  
• You manage the customer relation daily and (pro-) actively to create a lock-in opportunity and retain Customer satisfaction.  
• You build a customer relationship through high standard service delivery and execution.  
• You highten awareness and inform the client of successful products  
• You inform and share knowledge with other stake-holders within the company to inform and update on this new transport relation
Customer behavior
  
• You discuss and try to understand the booking behaviors and needs of the Customer via commercial discussions based on KPI’s (in relation to SLA)  
• You sharing info about the customer behavior with commercial stake-holders (commercial Margin Management/Key accountmanagers/Inside Sales/...)
Communication
  
• You are pro-actively by thinking with the customer, assessing and acting before possible incidents.  
• You assure the tracking & tracing (within office hours) via Customer Portal and other ways (digitalization is key and our future aim)  
• You receive and assist the Customer with his complaint within our organisation and stakeholders

Who are we looking for?

As a Customer Service Representative, you are primarily focused on customer service. You have a commercial mentality and are able to communicate with the customer in a professional way.
  
• You have a bachelor degree or equivalent through experience;  
• You have strong communication skills and are able to understand and translate the customers needs;  
• You speak English fluently. A good knowledge of French and Dutch is required. Knowledge of German or another language is a plus;  
• You have experience in managing an account and you are able to work on customer relations and loyalty;  
• You have knowledge of the various Microsoft Office programs and are quick to learn proprietary systems;  
• You are organized, detail-oriented and have the drive to work in a commercial and professional manner;  
• You have the necessary persuasiveness and commercial flair, are proactive and can work alone as well as in a team;  
• You are a multitasker and are someone who values efficiency;  
• You can cope with a changing environment.

Antwerp Convention Bureau (ACB – www.antwerpconventionbureau.be) focuses on promoting the city of Antwerp as a premium destination for meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events (MICE). Their brand promise is ‘The city is your venue’. Antwerp Convention Bureau highlights the diverse range of conference facilities in Antwerp and builds strong local expertise to support conference organizers and attendees in hosting conferences and business activities within the city.
The goal is to use a comprehensive marketing strategy and a proactive approach to attract international B-2-B events for associations or the industry that generate a positive impact on the residents, entrepreneurs, and visitors of the city of Antwerp. These events reinforce local and regional policies because they are linked to strong economic clusters, knowledge institutions, or centers of expertise.
In order to expand its organization and network, Antwerp Convention Bureau is actively seeking a new Managing Director.

Jobomschrijving

As Managing Director, you are the driving force behind the long-term strategy and financial performance of the organisation. Taking full P&L responsibility, you safeguard the financial health and ensure a maximum return on investment for the allocated budgets. You build on the current momentum by prioritizing the structuring of the organisation, implementing clear processes, and inspiring the internal team. Furthermore, you act as the primary local and international ambassador who proudly carries the bureau's successes to the city and its stakeholders, further shaping its vision within the meeting and convention (MICE) industry. 
As Managing Director, you will be responsible for:

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.
• Representing ACB with strong communication skills. Expanding the (inter)national network within the highly competitive meeting industry. Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.
• A background in the (inter)national hospitality industry, or experience as a senior business marketing and sales professional within a highly competitive international sector. Experience within the MICE sector is considered a strong asset, though leadership skills are prioritized.
• A strict commitment to being based in Antwerp alongside a readiness to travel internationally.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

To support our further growth ambitions, Brantsandpatents is looking for a 
Patent Advisor or (partially qualified) European Patent Attorney 
with a background in chemistry, preferable organic chemistry.
 

As a Patent Advisor, you will analyze the R&D activities and innovations of your clients and develop an appropriate IP strategy based on this analysis.

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English. 

• Interest in legal principles and patent law. 

• Willingness to invest in training to become a patent attorney.
